135:           title: resolved ? 'Resolved' : 'Removed',
136:           detail: resolved

138:             : `${card.name} removed from tracker`,
139:         });

143:           ...prev.game,
144:           cards: prev.game.cards.filter((c) => c.instanceId !== instanceId),

153:   const setCount = useCallback((instanceId: string, count: number) => {
154:     setTracker((prev) => {
155:       let log = prev.game.log;
156:       const cards = prev.game.cards.map((c) => {
157:         if (c.instanceId !== instanceId) return c;

174:     });

178:    * Manual override ΓÇö step a card's counters up or down. The arithmetic runs
179:    * against `prev`, so rapid +/ΓêÆ taps accumulate instead of each recomputing

181:    */
182:   const adjustCount = useCallback((instanceId: string, delta: number) => {
183:     setTracker((prev) => {
184:       let log = prev.game.log;
185:       const cards = prev.game.cards.map((c) => {
186:         if (c.instanceId !== instanceId) return c;
187:         const to = clampCount(c.count + delta, c.direction, c.targetCount);
188:         if (to !== c.count) {

190:             turn: prev.game.turn,

192:             detail: `${c.name} ${to > c.count ? '+1' : 'ΓêÆ1'} ΓåÆ ${to}`,
193:           });
194:         }

197:         const fadeExhausted = c.mechanic === 'fading' && to > 0 ? false : c.fadeExhausted;

199:       });

201:     });
202:   }, []);

205:     const safe = Number.isFinite(turn) ? Math.max(1, Math.round(turn)) : 1;
206:     setTracker((prev) => {
207:       if (safe === prev.game.turn) return prev;
208:       const log = appendLog(prev.game.log, {
209:         turn: safe,
210:         title: 'Turn changed',
211:         detail: `Turn set to ${safe} (was ${prev.game.turn})`,
212:       });
213:       return { ...prev, game: { ...prev.game, turn: safe, log } };
214:     });
215:   }, []);

217:   /**
218:    * Advances to the player's next turn. This runs the two turn steps that
219:    * matter for the mechanics this app tracks, in the order they actually
220:    * happen, as one atomic update:
221:    *
222:    * 1. Upkeep ΓÇö Suspend, Vanishing, and Fading counters tick down one step.
223:    * 2. Precombat main ΓÇö each tracked Saga gains a lore counter, and any
224:    *    chapter ability that lore count newly reaches triggers individually
225:    *    (not just the final one), matching how Sagas actually work: a
226:    *    chapter ability triggers the moment its number is reached, well
227:    *    before the Saga is sacrificed at the end of its final chapter.
228:    *

230:    * re-triggering. The summary of what changed is stored alongside the new
231:    * game state so the two can never disagree.
232:    *
233:    * This is distinct from the Time Travel keyword action (see
234:    * applyTimeTravel below): Next Turn is the automatic, once-per-turn

240:     setTracker((prev) => {
241:       const changes: TurnChange[] = [];
242: 
243:       // Step 1 ΓÇö upkeep: Suspend/Vanishing/Fading count down.
244:       const afterUpkeep = prev.game.cards.map((c) => {
245:         if (c.mechanic === 'saga' || !c.autoAdjust || hasHitTarget(c)) return c;

247:         // CR 702.32b: Fading removes a fade counter at upkeep same as the
248:         // others, but only sacrifices once removal *fails* ΓÇö the upkeep
249:         // after the count already reached 0, not the upkeep it gets there.
250:         if (c.mechanic === 'fading' && c.count <= 0) {
251:           changes.push({
252:             instanceId: c.instanceId,
253:             name: c.name,
254:             mechanic: c.mechanic,
255:             step: 'upkeep',
256:             from: c.count,
257:             to: c.count,
258:             hitTarget: true,
259:             resolveNote: c.resolveNote,
260:           });
261:           return { ...c, fadeExhausted: true };
262:         }
263: 
264:         const to = clampCount(
265:           c.count + (c.direction === 'decrement' ? -1 : 1),
266:           c.direction,
267:           c.targetCount,
268:         );
269:         changes.push({
270:           instanceId: c.instanceId,
271:           name: c.name,
272:           mechanic: c.mechanic,
273:           step: 'upkeep',
274:           from: c.count,
275:           to,
276:           // A successful removal is never itself the sacrifice trigger, even
277:           // when it brings a Fading card to exactly 0 ΓÇö see the branch above.
278:           hitTarget:
279:             c.mechanic === 'fading'
280:               ? false
281:               : hasHitTarget({
282:                   mechanic: c.mechanic,
283:                   count: to,
284:                   direction: c.direction,
285:                   targetCount: c.targetCount,
286:                 }),
287:           resolveNote: c.resolveNote,
288:         });
289:         return { ...c, count: to };
290:       });
291: 
292:       // Step 2 ΓÇö precombat main: Sagas gain a lore counter; crossed chapters trigger.
293:       const cards = afterUpkeep.map((c) => {
294:         if (c.mechanic !== 'saga' || !c.autoAdjust || hasHitTarget(c)) return c;
295:         const to = clampCount(c.count + 1, c.direction, c.targetCount);
296:         const chapters = c.chapters ?? [];
297:         const triggeredNow = newlyTriggeredChapters(
298:           chapters,
299:           c.count,
300:           to,
301:           c.triggeredChapters ?? [],
302:         );
303:         const hitTarget = hasHitTarget({
304:           mechanic: c.mechanic,
305:           count: to,
306:           direction: c.direction,
307:           targetCount: c.targetCount,
308:         });
309:         if (triggeredNow.length === 0) {
310:           changes.push({
311:             instanceId: c.instanceId,
312:             name: c.name,
313:             mechanic: c.mechanic,
314:             step: 'precombatMain',
315:             from: c.count,
316:             to,
317:             hitTarget,
318:             resolveNote: c.resolveNote,
319:           });
320:         } else {
321:           for (const chapter of triggeredNow) {
322:             changes.push({
323:               instanceId: c.instanceId,
324:               name: c.name,
325:               mechanic: c.mechanic,
326:               step: 'precombatMain',
327:               from: c.count,
328:               to,
329:               hitTarget: hitTarget && chapter.number === chapters.length,
330:               resolveNote: c.resolveNote,
331:               chapter,
332:             });
333:           }
334:         }
335:         return {
336:           ...c,
337:           count: to,
338:           triggeredChapters: [...(c.triggeredChapters ?? []), ...triggeredNow.map((t) => t.number)],
339:         };
340:       });

342:       const turn = prev.game.turn + 1;

349:           mechanic: c.mechanic,
350:           from: c.from,
351:           to: c.to,
352:         })),
353:       });

355:         game: { ...prev.game, turn, cards, log },

363:    * Time Travel keyword action: "For each suspended card you own and each
364:    * permanent you control with a time counter on it, you may add or remove
365:    * a time counter." Each choice is capped to exactly one counter in either
366:    * direction ΓÇö this isn't a free stepper, it's one pass of the real
367:    * keyword's per-object choice. Unlike Next Turn this never touches the
368:    * turn counter, and the +1/ΓêÆ1 choice isn't limited by a card's own
369:    * direction ΓÇö the keyword can add a counter to a Suspend card just as
370:    * freely as removing one.

Verified via web search against the Comprehensive Rules and reliable
